interpretation: Correct temporal alignment of real peripheral physiology carries statistically detectable predictive information relative to a within-subject×video circular-shift control that preserves multivariate trajectory structure and circular autocorrelation.
Despite this real alignment signal, adding aligned physiology to video/time plus immediately prior self-report worsens held-out MAE in the frozen O002 primary result.
The defensible synthesis is real physiological signal but no incremental short-horizon forecasting utility beyond recent reported state and context under this model/features/dataset.
Effect magnitudes of the alignment advantage are small; statistical detection should not be confused with large practical utility.
